package emptyread

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	lsfWit "example.invalid/emptyread/wit"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

var ErrClosed = net.ErrClosed
var deadlineExceeded = os.ErrDeadlineExceeded

func lsfStreamUnsupported() error { return errors.ErrUnsupported }

type lsfStreamError struct{ failure int }

func (e *lsfStreamError) Error() string { return "provider-error" }

type OpError struct {
	Op, Net string
	Addr    any
	Err     error
}

func (e *OpError) Error() string { return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %v", e.Op, e.Err) }
func (e *OpError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }

type lsfStreamConn struct {
	mu                                               sync.Mutex
	stream                                           *wire
	remote                                           string
	readDeadline, writeDeadline                      time.Time
	readBusy, writeBusy, closing, readEOF, writeShut bool
}

func conn() *lsfStreamConn { return &lsfStreamConn{stream: &wire{}} }

type wire struct {
	calls, closes int
	data          []byte
	end           bool
}
type readResult struct {
	w       *wire
	maximum uint32
}

func (w *wire) ReadContext(_ context.Context, maximum uint32, _ lsfWit.Option[uint32]) readResult {
	w.calls++
	return readResult{w: w, maximum: maximum}
}
func (r readResult) IsErr() bool     { return false }
func (r readResult) Err() int        { return 0 }
func (r readResult) Ok() chunkOption { return chunkOption{w: r.w} }

type chunkOption struct{ w *wire }

func (o chunkOption) IsNone() bool { return o.w.end }
func (o chunkOption) Some() *chunk { return &chunk{w: o.w} }

type chunk struct{ w *wire }

func (c *chunk) Close()                                     { c.w.closes++ }
func (c *chunk) BytesContext(_ context.Context) bytesResult { return bytesResult{data: c.w.data} }

type bytesResult struct{ data []byte }

func (r bytesResult) IsErr() bool { return false }
func (r bytesResult) Err() int    { return 0 }
func (r bytesResult) Ok() []byte  { return r.data }

func TestZeroReadExpiredNoDispatch(t *testing.T) {
	c := conn()
	c.readDeadline = time.Now().Add(-time.Second)
	n, err := c.Read(nil)
	if n != 0 || err != nil || c.stream.calls != 0 || c.readBusy {
		t.Fatalf("empty-expired: n=%d err=%v calls=%d busy=%v", n, err, c.stream.calls, c.readBusy)
	}
}

func TestZeroReadEOFNoDispatch(t *testing.T) {
	c := conn()
	c.readEOF = true
	n, err := c.Read([]byte{})
	if n != 0 || err != nil || c.stream.calls != 0 || c.readBusy {
		t.Fatal("empty-eof")
	}
}

func TestZeroReadClosedAndBusyKeepProfileRules(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		closed, busy bool
		expected     error
	}{
		{true, false, net.ErrClosed},
		{false, true, errors.ErrUnsupported},
		{true, true, net.ErrClosed},
	} {
		c := conn()
		c.closing, c.readBusy = tc.closed, tc.busy
		n, err := c.Read(nil)
		if n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, tc.expected) || c.stream.calls != 0 || c.readBusy != tc.busy {
			t.Fatalf("empty-admission: closed=%v busy=%v n=%d err=%v calls=%d", tc.closed, tc.busy, n, err, c.stream.calls)
		}
	}
}

func TestNonemptyExpiredStillRefusesBeforeDispatch(t *testing.T) {
	c := conn()
	c.readDeadline = time.Now().Add(-time.Second)
	n, err := c.Read(make([]byte, 1))
	if n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, deadlineExceeded) || c.stream.calls != 0 || c.readBusy {
		t.Fatal("nonempty-expired")
	}
}

func TestNonemptyReadPreservesProviderPathAndEOF(t *testing.T) {
	c := conn()
	c.stream.data = []byte("a")
	dst := make([]byte, 2)
	n, err := c.Read(dst)
	if n != 1 || err != nil || string(dst[:n]) != "a" || c.stream.calls != 1 || c.stream.closes != 1 || c.readBusy {
		t.Fatal("nonempty-data")
	}
	c.stream.end = true
	n, err = c.Read(dst)
	if n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || c.stream.calls != 2 || !c.readEOF || c.readBusy {
		t.Fatal("nonempty-eof")
	}
	n, err = c.Read(nil)
	if n != 0 || err != nil || c.stream.calls != 2 {
		t.Fatal("empty-after-eof")
	}
}

func TestPinnedNativeTCPZeroReadDeadlineEOFAndClose(t *testing.T) {
	ln, err := net.ListenTCP("tcp4", &net.TCPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer ln.Close()
	accepts := make(chan *net.TCPConn, 1)
	failures := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		c, err := ln.AcceptTCP()
		if err != nil {
			failures <- err
			return
		}
		accepts <- c
	}()
	client, err := net.DialTCP("tcp4", nil, ln.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer client.Close()
	var peer *net.TCPConn
	select {
	case peer = <-accepts:
	case err = <-failures:
		t.Fatal(err)
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("accept-timeout")
	}
	defer peer.Close()
	if err = client.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(-time.Second)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if n, err := client.Read(nil); n != 0 || err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("reference-empty-expired: %d %v", n, err)
	}
	if n, err := client.Read(make([]byte, 1)); n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, deadlineExceeded) {
		t.Fatalf("reference-nonempty-expired: %d %v", n, err)
	}
	if err = client.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = peer.CloseWrite(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if n, err := client.Read(make([]byte, 1)); n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		t.Fatalf("reference-eof: %d %v", n, err)
	}
	if n, err := client.Read(nil); n != 0 || err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("reference-empty-eof: %d %v", n, err)
	}
	if err = client.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if n, err := client.Read(nil); n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, net.ErrClosed) {
		t.Fatalf("reference-empty-closed: %d %v", n, err)
	}
}
